  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The learning/instructional experience under remote or non-traditional (e.g., online/asynchronous) delivery, as reflected in student open responses",

    {"name": "engagement_trajectory", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures how student engagement evolved, a core facet of the remote-learning experience theme."},
    {"name": "subject_format_alignment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Assesses fit between subject and delivery format, directly on the instructional-experience focus."},
    {"name": "hands_on_instruction_impact", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Themes the loss of practical/lab instruction under remote delivery."},
    {"name": "peer_interaction_loss", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Social/collaborative facet of the remote-learning experience."},
    {"name": "teacher_pedagogical_strategy", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Instructional adaptation facet, coherent with the focus."},

    {"name": "parental_involvement_demand", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Home-support facet of remote learning, though heavily not_applicable/null suggesting weak grounding."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.82,
  "structure_quality": 0.78,
  "focus_actionability": 0.8,
  "rationale": "The columns converge coherently on a single implied focus: the student experience of remote/online (notably asynchronous) instruction, decomposed into well-differentiated thematic facets (engagement, format fit, hands-on loss, peer interaction, teacher adaptation, async advantages, parental support). This is a genuine theme extraction rather than a grab-bag, and the facets sit at a useful granularity with categorical distinctions an analyst could act on (e.g., which subjects suffer format misalignment, where hands-on loss is critical). Weaknesses: the query only asks generically about 'themes' with no signal of remote/online context, so the system has read in a fairly specific pandemic/online-learning frame that may not be data-inferable; several columns (asynchronous_format_advantage, parental_involvement_demand) are dominated by NULL/not_applicable/not_relevant values, indicating those facets are poorly grounded in the actual responses and thin the structure. Overall a strong, coherent, actionable inferred focus with moderate over-specification and some sparsely-populated facets."
}
